    -- Cover screen

        local s = Instance.new("Sky", Lighting)
        s.SkyboxBk = "]]..decalID..[["

        s.SkyboxFt = "]]..decalID..[["
        s.SkyboxLf = "]]..decalID..[["

    for _,p in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            for _,face in pairs(Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems()) do
                local d = Instance.new("Decal")
                d.Face = face
                d.Texture = "]]..decalID..[["
                d.Parent = p
            end

    -- Play Scream
    for _,plr in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do

        frame.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
        frame.BorderSizePixel = 3

        local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)
        title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
        title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        title.Text = "ZopGui 4.2"
        title.Font = Enum.Font.Antique
        title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        title.TextScaled = true

            b.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30)
            b.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, yPos)
            b.Text = text
            b.Font = Enum.Font.Antique
            b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
            b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
            b.BorderColor3 = Color3.new(0,1,0)
            b.TextScaled = true
            b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(func)
        end

            for i = 1,20 do
                local t = Instance.new("Part", workspace)
                t.Size = Vector3.new(4,4,4)
                t.Position = Vector3.new(math.random(-100,100), 100, math.random(-100,100))

                t.Name = "Toad"
                local decal = Instance.new("Decal", t)
                decal.Texture = "rbxassetid://73318024625962"

                if p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then

        makeButton("Spin Map", 130, function()
            for _,p in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                if p:IsA("Model") or p:IsA("BasePart") then
                    spawn(function()
                        while true do
                            p.CFrame = p.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0,0.05,0)
                            wait(0.1)
                        end

        end)

        makeButton("Broadcast Message", 170, function()
            for _,pl in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if pl ~= plr then
                    local m = Instance.new("Message", pl:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
                    m.Text = "zopzop_32 hacked this game"
                    delay(5, function() m:Destroy() end)
                end

        makeButton("Backdoor Finder", 210, function()
            local count = 0
            for _,v in pairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
                if v:IsA("RemoteEvent") then

            print("Found "..count.." RemoteEvents.")
